hear-no-dub.name: Hear No Dub
hear-no-dub.toast.none: No subtitles found for "%s". Press K to search
hear-no-dub.toast.unsure: Not sure which episode this is. Press %s to pick
hear-no-dub.toast.no_key: Add a SubDL or OpenSubtitles API key in the config (Sources) to fetch subtitles
hear-no-dub.status.idle: Auto search is off. Search below or pick a local file
hear-no-dub.status.no_key: No subtitle source set up (Settings > Sources needs a SubDL or OpenSubtitles key)
hear-no-dub.status.found: %s results. Click one to use it
hear-no-dub.status.unsure: Couldn't tell which episode this is. Pick the right file below
hear-no-dub.picker.title: Hear No Dub: Subtitles
hear-no-dub.picker.nothing: Nothing is playing (start a video in your browser)
hear-no-dub.picker.unsupported: Media detection only works on Windows
hear-no-dub.picker.lines_hint: Pause right after a line is spoken, then click that line to sync
hear-no-dub.picker.no_lines: No lines near this point in the video
hear-no-dub.position.title: Move subtitles
hear-no-dub.position.hint: Drag the caption, then press Done
hear-no-dub.config.title: Hear No Dub
hear-no-dub.config.enabled.desc:
Turn subtitles on or off.
• Same as the J key.
hear-no-dub.config.auto_search.desc:
When a new video starts, find and load subtitles by itself.
• Only loads when it's sure it found the right episode.
• Otherwise press K to pick one.
hear-no-dub.config.toasts.desc: Small pop-ups when subtitles are found, missing or fail to load.
hear-no-dub.config.nudge.desc: How far one press of [ or ] moves the subtitles.
hear-no-dub.config.api_key.desc:
Needed to search and download.
• Stored in plain text.
hear-no-dub.config.username.desc: Optional: raises the daily download limit.
hear-no-dub.config.move.desc: Drag the caption box to where you want it.
hear-no-dub.config.width.desc:
Longer lines wrap.
• Up to 3 lines are shown.
hear-no-dub.status.found_from: %s results (%s). Click one to use it
hear-no-dub.config.group.subdl.desc:
Searched first: much higher free limits (thousands of searches, a few hundred downloads a day).
• Free key: sign up at subdl.com, open your profile, click "Copy API Code".
hear-no-dub.config.use_subdl.desc: Search SubDL (the old Subscene library, strong on anime).
hear-no-dub.config.subdl_key.desc:
From your subdl.com profile ("Copy API Code").
• Stored in plain text.
hear-no-dub.config.group.os.desc:
Free account at opensubtitles.com.
• Create an API key under Profile > API consumers.
• Username and password raise daily downloads from 5 to about 20.
hear-no-dub.config.group.jimaku.desc:
Anime subtitle archive at jimaku.cc.
• Mostly Japanese files: only English-looking ones are shown by default.
• Free key on your jimaku.cc account page.
hear-no-dub.config.use_jimaku.desc:
Search Jimaku too.
• Off by default because it's mostly Japanese.
hear-no-dub.config.jimaku_key.desc:
From jimaku.cc/account.
• Stored in plain text.
hear-no-dub.config.jimaku_japanese.desc: Also list Japanese subtitles (for language learners).
hear-no-dub.config.group.lyrics.desc:
Lyrics for Spotify and other music apps.
• Every source is searched, best first: word-synced, then line-synced, then plain.
• All results show up in the picker (K) with their source.
• Songs with only plain lyrics get them spread over the song, marked "not synced".
• You can also drop your own .lrc or .ttml files in config/hear-no-dub/subs.
hear-no-dub.config.use_lrclib.desc:
Free, open lyrics database (lrclib.net).
• Mostly synced line by line.
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_follow_music: Follow music when no video plays
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_follow_music.d:
Show lyrics for the music app when nothing else is playing.
• Off: music apps are only used when you switch to them in the picker.
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_word_by_word.d:
When the lyrics have word timings, reveal each word as it's sung.
• Works even with karaoke off.
hear-no-dub.status.lyrics_unsure: Lyrics found, but none match the song's length. Pick one below
hear-no-dub.toast.plain_lyrics: Only unsynced lyrics for %s. Lines are spread over the song
hear-no-dub.toast.lyrics_unsure: Not sure which version of this song it is. Press %s to pick
hear-no-dub.config.scale.desc: Size of the HUD caption text.
hear-no-dub.config.opacity.desc: How dark the box behind the HUD caption is.
hear-no-dub.config.anchor.desc:
Where Floating text goes:
• Follow my view: glides after your view
• New spot each line: each line appears in front of you and stays there
• Fixed in place: stays where you put it (bind "Place 3D subtitles here" in Controls)
hear-no-dub.config.world_distance.desc: How far in front of you the text floats.
hear-no-dub.config.world_height.desc:
Up or down from eye level.
• Negative = lower.
hear-no-dub.config.world_opacity.desc:
How dark the box behind 3D text is.
• Used by the Box style and speech bubbles.
hear-no-dub.config.world_see_through.des: Keep 3D text (and video screens) visible when a block is in the way.
hear-no-dub.msg.nothing_playing: Hear No Dub: no video to control
hear-no-dub.history.title: Recent lines (H to hide)
hear-no-dub.config.auto_pause.desc:
Pause the video when you open the Esc menu.
• Resumes when you go back to the game.
• Only resumes what the mod paused.
• Alt-tabbing doesn't pause.
hear-no-dub.config.screen_mode.desc:
How subtitles show on your screen:
• HUD caption: a box you can move
• Danmaku: lines fly across the screen like Niconico comments
• Action bar: above the hotbar
• Chat: each line posted once (only you see it)
• None: nothing on screen
hear-no-dub.config.world_mode.desc:
How subtitles show in the 3D world (works together with "On screen"):
• Floating: in front of you, or fixed in place
• Pop-in: each line pops up at a random spot in your view
• Speech bubble: above the mob you look at, or above you
hear-no-dub.config.group.hud.desc: Settings for the "HUD caption" on-screen mode.
hear-no-dub.config.preset.desc:
How subtitles look:
• Movie: white with a black outline
• Glow: soft halo
• Box: text on a dark box
• Retro: gold text on a brown box
• Custom: the settings below
hear-no-dub.config.animation.desc: How lines appear and disappear (every mode).
hear-no-dub.config.karaoke.desc: Reveal each line word by word over the time it's on screen.
hear-no-dub.config.next_preview.desc:
Show the next line faintly under the current one.
• HUD caption and Floating only.
hear-no-dub.config.keep_formatting.desc:
Use italics and bold from the subtitle file.
• Often used for thoughts, flashbacks and off-screen voices.
hear-no-dub.config.speaker_colors.desc:
Give each speaker their own color.
• Only when the file names them (.ass files, or "NAME:" lines).
hear-no-dub.config.group.custom.desc: Used when Style is set to Custom.
hear-no-dub.config.text_color.desc:
Color of the text.
• Speaker colors override it.
hear-no-dub.config.shadow.desc: Minecraft's drop shadow under the text.
hear-no-dub.config.glow.desc: A soft halo around the text.
hear-no-dub.config.box.desc:
A box behind the text.
• Its opacity is under Subtitles (HUD caption / 3D text).
hear-no-dub.config.group.popin3d.desc:
Each line (or each word) lands on a block you can see, as real 3D letters.
• Turns toward you when it lands, then stays put.
• Always lands in view, ahead of you when you walk, never in your face.
• With word-synced lyrics the words light up and move as they are sung.
• Old lines sink into the ground as the next one lands.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_style.desc:
What the letters look like.
• Thick 3D: solid block letters.
• Chiseled: bevelled edges that catch the light.
• Balloon: puffy, shiny, inflated.
• Neon: glowing tubes along the letter edges, lights up the area.
• Glass: see-through with bright edges.
• Hologram: flickering sci-fi scan lines.
• Flat: crisp text with an outline.
• Tiny cubes: a statue made of little cubes.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_animation.desc:
How letters arrive and leave.
• Drop in: each letter falls and bounces, then sinks away.
• Rise: the line grows out of the block and sinks back in.
• Particles: letters pop in with sparkles and leave in a puff.
• Fade: a soft fade in and out.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_scale.desc:
Size of the letters.
• 1.00× = one letter pixel is one block pixel.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_min_distance.d: Words never spawn closer than this. Big letters keep a bit more room on top of it.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_distance.desc: How far words can spawn when you stand still. While you walk, sprint or fly, words spawn farther ahead so they reach a normal distance by the time you get to them.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_spread.desc: How far from the crosshair a line can land.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_shadow.desc: Soft shadows on the block under each letter.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_glow.desc:
The letters light up the blocks around them in their colour.
• Like the video screen glow.
• Looks best at night and with shaders.
How bright the light from the letters is.
hear-no-dub.config.popin_distance.desc: How far away the lines appear.
hear-no-dub.config.popin_spread_x.desc: How far to the side of the crosshair lines can appear.
hear-no-dub.config.popin_spread_y.desc: How far above or below the crosshair lines can appear.
hear-no-dub.config.group.bubble.desc:
Settings for the Speech bubble 3D mode.
• "Who's talking" is also used by the "Above a mob" video mode.
hear-no-dub.config.bubble_target.desc:
Who gets the bubble:
• Auto: whoever you look at right now, else you
• Looked-at mob: picked when a line starts, kept for that line
• Me: always above your head (see it in F5)
hear-no-dub.config.bubble_range.desc: How far away a mob can be to get the bubble.
hear-no-dub.config.world_follow_delay.de:
"Follow my view" only.
• How long the text takes to catch up when you turn or walk.
• 0 = glued to your view.
hear-no-dub.config.per_line_random.desc:
"New spot each line" only.
• Each line appears at a random spot in your view (uses the Pop-in spread) instead of straight ahead.
hear-no-dub.config.billboard.desc:
How 3D text turns toward you:
• Turn toward me: always points straight at you
• Turn toward me, stay vertical: turns left/right but never leans back
• Flat to screen: parallel to your screen
• Flat to screen, copy tilt: like name tags
hear-no-dub.config.third_person_bubble.d:
In third person (F5), show speech bubbles instead of your normal 3D mode.
• Back to normal in first person.
hear-no-dub.osd.volume_failed: Couldn't change %s's volume (is it playing sound?)
hear-no-dub.skip.info.movie: Skip times: not used for movies
hear-no-dub.skip.info.no_episode: Skip times: couldn't work out the episode number
hear-no-dub.skip.info.no_anime: Skip times: couldn't find "%s" on AniList
hear-no-dub.skip.info.none: Skip times: none yet for %s episode %s (the skip key jumps ahead instead)
hear-no-dub.picker.lines_hint_jump: Click a line to jump the video there
hear-no-dub.config.volume_step.desc:
How much one press of - / = changes the volume.
• Changes the browser's own volume (its slider in Windows' volume mixer), not your whole PC.
hear-no-dub.config.media_popup.desc: Show the time or volume at the top of the screen after skipping or changing the volume.
hear-no-dub.config.group.skip.desc:
Times come from AniSkip (the database many anime sites use for their skip buttons).
• The show is looked up on AniList.
hear-no-dub.config.skip_times.desc:
Show "Skip opening [O]" while an opening, ending or recap plays.
• Sends the show name and episode number to AniList and AniSkip.
hear-no-dub.config.auto_skip_opening.des:
Skip openings and recaps by themselves after a countdown.
• Seeking back into one won't skip it again.
hear-no-dub.config.auto_skip_ending.desc:
Skip endings by themselves too.
• Off by default: some shows have scenes after the ending.
hear-no-dub.config.auto_skip_delay.desc:
How long "Skipping opening in…" shows first.
• Press O to skip right away.
hear-no-dub.config.skip_fallback.desc:
When no opening or ending is known, O jumps ahead this far.
• 85 s is a typical anime opening.
hear-no-dub.video.no_window: Can't find the %s window. Open the video in it.
hear-no-dub.video.minimized: %s is minimized. Restore it (it can stay behind the game).
hear-no-dub.video.unsupported: Video in game only works on Windows
hear-no-dub.config.video_enabled.desc:
Show your browser's video in the game.
• Same as the V key.
• The browser window can be behind the game, but not minimized.
hear-no-dub.config.video_size.desc: Width of the box, in percent of the screen width.
hear-no-dub.config.video_quality.desc:
Max picture height.
• Higher looks sharper but uses more CPU.
hear-no-dub.config.video_fps.desc:
Pictures per second grabbed from the browser.
• Each one takes about 20–30 ms of CPU.
hear-no-dub.config.video_mode.desc:
Where the video shows (N switches between them):
• Picture-in-picture: a box on your screen
• Faded background: fills the screen, see-through
• Floating: a screen in front of you
• Floating, to the side: the same, but off to the side
• TV: fixed in the world (place it with B)
• Above a mob: a small screen above a mob
hear-no-dub.config.video_move.desc:
Drag the box to move it.
• Drag its corner (or scroll) to resize it.
hear-no-dub.config.video_opacity.desc:
How see-through the video is.
• Picture-in-picture and screens in the world
• Faded background has its own setting
hear-no-dub.video_position.title: Move video
hear-no-dub.video_position.hint: Drag the box to move it · drag the corner or scroll to resize
hear-no-dub.config.video_world_width.des: Width of the screen, in blocks.
How far in front of you the screen floats.
hear-no-dub.config.video_world_height.de:
Up or down from eye level.
• Negative = lower.
hear-no-dub.config.video_mob_width.desc: Width of the screen, in blocks.
hear-no-dub.config.video_tv_width.desc:
Width of a newly placed TV, in blocks.
• Used when "Fit the wall" is off or doesn't apply.
hear-no-dub.config.video_tv_fit.desc:
On a wall, make the TV as big as the flat wall around the spot allows.
• Like a painting, up to 24×14 blocks.
hear-no-dub.msg.tv_wall: TV placed on the wall (up to %s × %s blocks) · ↑ / ↓ to resize
hear-no-dub.msg.tv_stand: TV placed on the block · ↑ / ↓ to resize
hear-no-dub.msg.tv_hang: TV hung from the ceiling · ↑ / ↓ to resize
hear-no-dub.msg.tv_float: TV placed in the air · ↑ / ↓ to resize
hear-no-dub.msg.tv_none: No TV in this world yet. Press %s to place one
hear-no-dub.video.place_tv: No TV here yet. Look at a wall (or anywhere) and press %s
hear-no-dub.config.video_subs_attach.des:
Show 3D subtitles on the video screen instead of their own 3D mode:
• Under the screen (above it for a mob screen)
• Sized to match the screen
On-screen (HUD) subtitles aren't affected.
hear-no-dub.config.video_distance_volume:
The farther you are from the screen, the quieter the browser gets.
• Your volume comes back when you turn this off, switch modes or quit.
• While on, - / = change the full volume.
hear-no-dub.config.video_volume_range.de:
Distance where the sound is gone.
• Full volume within 3 blocks.
hear-no-dub.config.group.world3d.desc: Shared by every 3D mode, and by the floating video screens.
hear-no-dub.config.group.video_pip.desc: Settings for the Picture-in-picture video mode.
hear-no-dub.config.group.video_backgroun: Settings for the Faded background video mode.
Settings for "Floating" and "Floating, to the side".
• Facing and "Show through blocks" are under Subtitles > 3D text.
hear-no-dub.config.video_side_angle.desc:
"Floating, to the side" only.
• How far to the right of your view the screen sits.
• Negative = to the left.
hear-no-dub.config.video_side_tilt.desc:
"Floating, to the side" only.
• How far above your view the screen sits.
• Negative = below.
hear-no-dub.config.video_follow_delay.de:
How long the screen takes to catch up when you turn or walk.
• 0 = glued to your view.
hear-no-dub.config.group.video_tv.desc:
Press B to place the TV:
• Looking at a wall: hangs flat on it
• Looking at the top of a block: stands on it
• Looking at a ceiling: hangs from it
• Otherwise: floats in front of you
Resize it with ↑ / ↓. One TV per world, saved.
hear-no-dub.config.video_tv_distance.des: How far in front of you a TV placed in the air goes.
hear-no-dub.config.group.video_mob.desc:
Settings for the "Above a mob" video mode.
• Who gets the screen: "Who's talking" under Subtitles > Speech bubble.
hear-no-dub.config.video_mob_lift.desc: Gap between the mob's head and the screen.
hear-no-dub.config.group.video_world.des: For Floating, TV and Above a mob.
hear-no-dub.video_menu.title: Video in game
hear-no-dub.video_menu.tv_none: No TV in this world yet: press %s in game to place it
hear-no-dub.video_menu.tv_placed: Press %s in game to move the TV
hear-no-dub.crop.title: Fix video area
hear-no-dub.crop.hint: Drag the edges or corners · drag the middle to move it
hear-no-dub.crop.off: Turn the video on first (V, or the Video button)
hear-no-dub.config.group.danger.desc:
Pauses the video when you could actually die, plays it again once you're safe.
• Only resumes what it paused itself.
• Not in creative or spectator.
• U snoozes it for 10 minutes (farming, raids).
hear-no-dub.config.danger_pause.desc: Turn danger pause on or off.
hear-no-dub.config.danger_range.desc:
Careful only.
• How close a hostile mob has to be to count.
hear-no-dub.config.danger_resume.desc: Seconds of safety before the video plays again.
hear-no-dub.config.group.danmaku.desc:
Settings for the Danmaku on-screen mode.
• Lines fly right to left, each in its own lane.
• They freeze when the video is paused.
hear-no-dub.config.danmaku_seconds.desc:
Seconds a line takes to cross the screen.
• Lower = faster.
hear-no-dub.config.danmaku_area.desc: How much of the screen, from the top, the lanes use.
hear-no-dub.config.danmaku_opacity.desc: How see-through the flying text is.
hear-no-dub.config.video_glow.desc:
The screen lights up its surroundings in the colours of the picture:
• a soft halo around the screen
• for a TV, a pool of light on the floor in front of it
Off = 0.
hear-no-dub.config.danger_level.desc:
What counts as danger:
• Relaxed: only your health (below the health limit and getting hurt, or a big hit)
• Careful: also hostile mobs moving toward you at your level, and creepers about to explode
Careful ignores mobs while you're fighting (you hit a mob in the last 10 s).
hear-no-dub.config.danger_health.desc: Below this much health, any damage pauses the video.
hear-no-dub.config.danger_burst.desc:
Losing this many hearts within 3 seconds pauses the video, whatever your health.
• Berry bushes and small falls stay below it.
hear-no-dub.danger.snoozed: Danger pause snoozed for 10 minutes (U to turn it back on)
hear-no-dub.config.use_betterlyrics.desc:
Free word and syllable synced lyrics (better-lyrics.boidu.dev).
• Includes background vocals.
• Best for karaoke effects.
hear-no-dub.config.use_netease.desc:
NetEase Cloud Music: a huge catalogue, often word-synced.
• Unofficial: may stop working at any time.
• Strong on Asian music, decent on everything else.
hear-no-dub.config.use_lyricsovh.desc:
Plain lyrics as a last resort (not synced).
• Lines are spread over the song.
How song lyrics look on screen (HUD caption mode).
• Every word is timed: word-synced lyrics use real timings, others are guessed.
• Videos keep the normal caption look.
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_view.desc:
How the lines are arranged.
• Stacked: previous and next lines above and below, lines glide up.
• Current line: only the line being sung.
• Classic: the normal caption, like videos.
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_reveal.desc:
What words look like before they are sung.
• Dimmed: the whole line is there, faded.
• Word by word: each word pops in as it is sung.
• Letter by letter: letters appear across the word.
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_effect.desc:
What the word being sung does.
• Lift: rises and grows a little.
• Bounce: hops when it starts.
• Glow: a soft halo.
• Wave: its letters ripple.
• Jelly: squashes and wobbles.
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_fill.desc: Colour fills each word from left to right as it is sung.
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_emphasis.desc: WORDS IN CAPS and words with "!" shake, grow and turn warm while sung.
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_title_card.des: Song title and artist slide in when a song starts.
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_scale.desc: Size of the lyrics, on top of the caption text size.
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_dim.desc: How visible words not sung yet are (and the lines around).
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_highlight.desc: Colour words turn as they are sung.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_font.desc:
Font of the letters.
• Fonts that come with the mod: Poster, Comic, Rounded, Chunky, Marker, Script, Lobster, Elegant, Gothic, Retro, Future, Stencil, Horror, Arcade, Tall, Neon lines, Blocky.
• From your computer: Bold, Serif, Impact, Mono.
• Enchanting / Illager runes: unreadable, just for the look.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_material.desc:
What the letters are made of.
• Text colour: the subtitle colours.
• Rainbow: colours flowing through the letters.
• The ground: the block they stand on (grass, sand, stone, planks...).
• Gold, Diamond, Amethyst, Ice.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_spawn.desc:
Where the letters go.
• Whole lines: each line lands on a block.
• Each word: every word lands on its own spot right as it is sung, in front of you as you move.
• Above a player/mob: the line floats above the one you are fighting or looking at (players too, great for PvP).
hear-no-dub.config.letter_karaoke.desc:
Use the Lyrics display (karaoke) settings on the 3D letters too.
• Upcoming words, colour sweep, the effect on the word being sung, held notes, shouted words.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_audio_react.de:
Letters pulse on the beat and the glow follows how loud the music is.
• Uses the real loudness of the app playing (Windows audio meter).
hear-no-dub.config.letter_landing_fx.des: Dust, a bump sound and a squash when letters land, sparkles on held notes and on the beat, and fireworks when the song ends.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_sound_volume.d: Volume of landing, knocking and smashing sounds.
hear-no-dub.config.studio.desc:
Change how lyrics look and see it live in the world.
• A demo song plays with a fake beat.
• Also opens with Y in game.
hear-no-dub.config.letterspawn.head: Above a player/mob
hear-no-dub.config.letter_director.desc: Prefer scenic spots: open sky, cliff edges with a view, water nearby, and toward the sun at sunrise and sunset.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_weather.desc: Rain soaks the letters: darker, shiny, and water drips off them. Snow slowly settles on their tops.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_mobs_look.desc: Mobs near a line that just landed turn their heads toward it.
hear-no-dub.config.letter_bands.desc:
The bass drum makes letters thump, hi-hats and cymbals make them sparkle.
• Listens to what your speakers play.
hear-no-dub.config.glow_mode.desc:
How glow is drawn when a shader pack is on.
• Auto: soft tint with shaders, additive without.
• Soft tint: see-through colour over the blocks; works with every pack.
• Additive: the vanilla way (can turn white with shaders).
• Emissive: lets the shader make it bloom (black with some packs, like Photon).
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_chorus.desc: Chorus lines are a little bigger and a shine sweeps across them (on screen and in 3D).
hear-no-dub.config.lyrics_upcoming.desc:
The next lines with a countdown on the left of the screen.
• Handy for planning a shot.
hear-no-dub.studio.title: Lyrics Studio
hear-no-dub.studio.hint: Left click: next · Right click: back
